name: Gyakushuu 4
source:
The latest installment in eroge maker ANIM's series of dark, sexy visual novel fantasies is here! Fans of tentacles, ahegao (sex-crazed faces), heroines in peril, sexual corruption and conquest, massive insertions, and other fantastical hardcore themes in eroge, will love this new story featuring an all new cast of characters (with a couple of recurring favorites in minor roles) in the tentacle-bursting disgrace scenarios that have come to define the series. An epic story in its own right, you'll be able to experience a tale of fantasy and betrayal, packed with the most erotic and deviant sex scenes you can imagine. Fallen princesses and female knights, dark-skinned demonesses and more all meet their fate at the hands of vengeful warlords, demons and otherworldly creatures. Dozens of hours of play, with deviant and frankly sexualized designs by popular hentai illustrator bbsacon.

[from [url=http://www.jlist.com/product/PCG0029]J-List[/url]]
translation:
成人游戏厂商ANIM旗下黑暗情色幻想视觉小说系列的最新作登场！喜爱触手、阿黑颜、陷入危机的女主角、性堕落与征服、巨大异物插入等硬核幻想题材的玩家，将在全新角色阵容中体验该系列标志性的触手爆裂凌辱场景，少数熟悉角色也会客串登场。

本作拥有独立而宏大的故事，以幻想与背叛为核心，塞满难以想象的淫荡变态性爱场景。堕落公主与女骑士、深肤色女恶魔等角色，都会落入复仇军阀、恶魔和异界生物手中。游戏时长达数十小时，角色造型由知名成人画师bbsacon设计，异常放纵且充满情色意味。
